title: I. The Bolted Room
objective: Come to your senses, and decide what sort of man you are going to be about it.
recap: You woke at a desk on Iron Cross Street in a body that was already sitting up, with the door bolted from the inside and a revolver by your right hand. Eight days later a man named Dunn Smith gave you a grey potion and a job.

title: II. The Company
objective: Take the black notebook case from the board at Blackthorn.
recap: Three deaths on the twenty-seventh of June, and one black hardcover notebook that all three of them had read. The Company took the case; you took it off the board.

title: III. The Rooms Above the Shop
objective: See Welch McGovern for yourself, in the rooms where he died.
recap: No wound, no poison, no struggle. A man at his own desk with his face turned towards something that was not there.

title: IV. Bolted from the Inside
objective: Establish how the rooms came to be sealed.
recap: Bolted, shuttered, and locked from within — the same room you woke up in, and you had begun to suspect that was not a coincidence.

title: V. The Apprentice
objective: Put the evening of the twenty-seventh to Hanass.
recap: Hanass had an account of that evening, and it was a better account than an honest man needs.

title: VI. What Killed Three People
objective: Work out what actually killed them.
recap: Not a hand, and not a poison. Something read at a particular hour, by three people who each thought they were alone with it.

title: VII. The Report
objective: Write the case up at the Company's desk and name whoever you can stand to name.
recap: The report went in. Whatever it left out went in the drawer with the rest of what the Company does not write down.

title: VIII. Sequence 8
objective: Digest the potion, find the Clown's formula, and take the rite at the circle.
recap: You drank the second one on purpose, which is the difference between an accident and a career.

title: IX. The Rest of the Ladder
objective: Work, keep the rent paid, and stay the sort of man who can explain every step of it.
